Class MachineType

java.lang.Object
fr.robie.machineengine.api.machine.MachineType
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.kyori.adventure.key.Keyed
public final class MachineType extends Object implements net.kyori.adventure.key.Keyed
What a machine is (ARCHITECTURE.md §12): storages, ports, extra capabilities, persisted data, upgrade slots, menu actions and lists (D40) and behavior. Immutable; one registered instance per type.
